mapper.select: select distinct mn.* from SYS_Role mn left join SYS_PositionP_Role ppr on ppr.Role_ID=mn.Role_ID left join SYS_Position_Role pr on pr.Role_ID=mn.Role_ID left join SYS_Position_User_P pup on pup.PP_ID=ppr.PP_ID left join SYS_Position_User pu on pu.P_ID=pr.P_ID where pup.U_ID=#{uId} or pu.U_ID=#{uId}

select distinct r.Role_Name as roleName, p.Power_Code as powerCode from SYS_Role_Power srp left join SYS_Power p on p.Power_ID=srp.Power_ID left join SYS_Role r on r.Role_ID=srp.Role_ID where p.Power_Type='1' and p.Power_Status='1' and r.Role_Name in
#{role}

select distinct mn.*, null as P_Id, null as P_Name, p.P_Name as ppName, d.D_Name as pdName, '岗位' as sourceType from SYS_Role mn left join SYS_Position_Role pr on pr.Role_ID = mn.Role_ID left join SYS_Position_User pu on pu.P_ID = pr.P_ID left join SYS_Position p on pu.P_ID = p.P_ID left join SYS_Department d on d.D_ID=p.D_ID
and pu.U_ID = #{params.uId}
and 1 = 0
and p.P_Name like concat('%', #{params.ppName}, '%')
and mn.Role_Name like concat('%', #{params.roleName}, '%')
union all select distinct mn.*, pro.P_Id, pro.P_Name, p.PP_Name as ppName, d.PD_Name as pdName, '项目岗位' as sourceType from SYS_Role mn left join SYS_PositionP_Role ppr on ppr.Role_ID = mn.Role_ID left join SYS_Position_User_P pup on pup.PP_ID = ppr.PP_ID left join SYS_Position_P p on pup.PP_ID = p.PP_ID left join SYS_Department_P d on d.PD_ID = p.PD_ID left join Pre_Project pro on pro.P_Id = d.P_Id
and pup.U_ID = #{params.uId}
and pro.P_Name like concat('%', #{params.pName}, '%')
and p.PP_Name like concat('%', #{params.ppName}, '%')
and mn.Role_Name like concat('%', #{params.roleName}, '%')

select distinct p.P_Name from SYS_Role mn left join SYS_Position_Role pr on pr.Role_ID = mn.Role_ID left join SYS_Position_User pu on pu.P_ID = pr.P_ID left join SYS_Position p on pu.P_ID = p.P_ID left join SYS_Department d on d.D_ID=p.D_ID where pu.U_ID = #{params.uId} and p.P_Name is not null
